_about: 2011-census side (c1) of the people-interpolation store for the 2010 federal election. The /map/ census-people lanes interpolate between bracketing censuses to election day on the SEIFA pcti lanes' day-share of the intercensal span (the f factor lives in data/booth-demo-2010.json's demoInterp record, written by the interp blend pass); this store is the far side ONLY — the measured side is the 2006-census venue store (data/booth-demo-2010.json). A booth's demo block is the 2011 Census Basic Community Profile counts of the 2011-census SA1 its premises coordinates (data/booth-seifa-2010.json) fall in, point-in-polygon against the ABS 1270.0.55.001 July 2011 SA1 shapes (derive-booth-seifa-hist.py's locate ladder) — the venue's neighbourhood, never the booth's voters. A division's row is the 2011 BCP whole-allocated to the boundary set the 2010 election ran on (seifa-src/sa1-2011-ced-2010ed.json) and summed, never an average of booth rows. Shares and income lanes are derive-booth-demo-2013.py's own readers re-run — same B01/B09/B26/B28/B40B/B45B bases (its curated birthplace-country cob lanes riding the B09 per-country cells in the 2013 store's COB_KEYS8 order), same adult re-weighting at data/income-dist.json's factors, the national 25th-percentile cut in 2011 dollars; this census universe is the 2013 store's, so incomeCuts matches it bit-for-bit and the national row within float summation tolerance (both asserted). A booth whose premises sit outside every 2011 SA1 polygon, or whose lat/lon are absent/(0,0), carries demo:null (counts.boothsPipMiss), as does one whose SA1 housed no one (boothsPipEmpty) — a missing c1 side leaves that booth's interpolated display cell to fall back to the measured block; inside a present block a lane is nulled rather than clamped when BCP perturbation would put its share outside [0,1].

sourceUrls.bcp: ABS 2011 Census Basic Community Profile, SA1 for AUST (B01/B09/B26/B28/B40B/B45B), abs.gov.au census datapacks

deliveryBasis: venue-proxy per booth (2011-census SA1 of the premises, point-in-polygon); whole-allocated 2011 BCP sum per division (sa1-2011-ced-2010ed.json)
